turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: That's an intriguing hypothetical! When a physical object like a strawberry blocks the mouth, it can affect speech production by altering the airflow and articulation needed to form certain sounds. This might make it harder to say 'hello' clearly, but people often compensate by adjusting their movements or using alternative sounds. It's a fascinating example of how the physical environment influences our communication.
